newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam demands return of patrol boats from China.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam demands return of patrol boats from China.

text.p: Vietnam said on Thursday that it had demanded the return of two patrol boats captured by a Chinese vessel in the Gulf of Tonkin last week.

"Two Vietnamese patrol boats carrying out operations in Vietnamese maritime territory were captured by a Chinese boat," the Foreign Ministry said in a brief statement. "Vietnam has asked China to return the boats and their crews to Vietnam."
The Lao Dong newspaper said the two vessels, on anti-smuggling patrol, had discovered and stopped a boat that was illegally shipping goods to China off the northern islands of Co To.

"Fifteen minutes later, while crew members of both patrol boats were making checks in the smuggling boat, a big ship with weapons came and started shooting to rescue the boat which had been captured...", the paper said.
Lao Dong said the armed ship then captured the two patrol vessels and 14 people who were on board, but two crew members escaped on a lifeboat and returned to the Vietnamese mainland.
